Selected: the new message tests (store, event-backed transitions incl. a write landing mid-transition, relations, operators, API 409 envelopes), the storage, relations, handoffs, operators and CRUD validation suites, the stale-revision cases of scope import, report sign-off and draft acceptance, and the predicate's Vitest file.
